verdict.rationale: Khoj's documented way to control data location is self-hosting: you run the server on your own hardware (Docker or Pip) and keep data on your device, which lets you pick exactly where data lives. There is no documented region or residency selection for Khoj Cloud, so the story is only met through the self-host deployment path. Missing for 10: region/residency selection for the hosted Khoj Cloud offering, explicit data-residency documentation, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: you can always choose to run Khoj on your own hardware, and never share your data outside of your device
You can generate your embeddings directly on your machine, and then use an offline chat client so that your data never leaves your machine.
You can self-host on consumer hardware for privacy
